title: AP’s note that AI has no feelings draws industry backlash
teaser: The Associated Press has updated its stylebook to say that AI has no feelings, drawing angry pushback from people in the AI industry. The note appeared Wednesday amid wider arguments about AI safety and consciousness. It defines anthropomorphism as attributing human traits, emotions or behavior to nonhuman beings and objects. The dispute is less about whether a style guide can settle a philosophical question than about why a cautious description of AI provoked such a sharp response.
